data.source_title: A work systems analysis of sterile processing: sterilization and case cart preparation
data.source_setting: Two sterile-processing facilities at a 700-bed academic medical center serving 56 clinics, 31 operating rooms and nine ambulatory centers, United States.
data.source_period: Observational data collection dates not specified in abstract; paper reports performance sampling and analysis of administrative tray-defect data.
data.source_n: 108 interruptions observed during case-cart preparation; 13.5 interruptions/hour reported
data.source_evidence_basis: Direct observation; article reports 108 interruptions, equivalent to 13.5 per hour, primarily phone calls.
data.limitations: Focused observation at one academic center; interruptions are not themselves delays or missed case starts. Administrative defect data represent a separate sample.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent sterile-processing case-cart work as interruption-prone and include a sensitivity parameter for interruptions; not a local event-rate estimate.

data.source_title: A work systems analysis of sterile processing: sterilization and case cart preparation
data.source_setting: Two sterile-processing facilities at a 700-bed academic medical center serving 56 clinics, 31 operating rooms and nine ambulatory centers, United States.
data.source_period: Observational data collection dates not specified in abstract; paper reports performance sampling and analysis of administrative tray-defect data.
data.quantity: Cases with at least one defective tray
data.source_evidence_basis: Retrospective administrative tray-defect dataset: 3,900 defects / 41,799 cases; authors report 9.3% with >=1 defective tray.
data.limitations: One academic center; a tray defect is not necessarily a delayed case, and defect categories include process issues beyond turnaround duration.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use only to motivate a scenario branch in which instrument readiness can fail; do not equate defect rate with OR delay probability.
